title: P256 512-record hop1 blocks, carried-emission registers, BFI receiver, both-pair backward operand reuse and Jacobian cold scalar multiplication

claims.statement: For the protected full-production P256 target, the cold classical algorithm in proof.md and supporting documents recovers the scalar with probability at least0.39 using at most96344103882122854252495177169274004307968 scalar instruction equivalents, below2^126.179535889234015 group units at C1000. q1=377471100,q2=2^28,N=2^70. Includes construction, normalization, range-tree control, capped carry/failure costs, fixed block-window transport with hop1 transaction-bound ACK and hop2 DONE-flag completion, grouping, resolution, verification and output. Peak memory below2^136bytes; preprocessing below2^118units included; no advice or auxiliary powers. Analytical bound under the stated ideal-coin blocking-port machine, not production execution or formal certification. Hop2 DONE markers plus per-phase STLR signaling awaited via the barrier LDAXR/WFE primitive replace per-message acknowledgment and sender in-flight updates (14/11 receiver with d3/d4 inserted by BFI into its 2^30-aligned cursor-table and 2^51 counter base registers, 85/4 per potential record); the hop1 full flush of512 records is charged at its measured2213 (2183 delivery, 10 in-flight, 19 publish, 1 reserve) with the window initialization/finishing row at16384*SIDE per node; the receive window is released only by the final flag load after all five packet words are in registers, so no mid-read publication can overwrite a packet; the first backward multiply preserves all four operand limbs (low pair by renaming its accumulator limbs to x1,x17; high pair by renaming the top accumulator limb to x28) and the second multiply omits both reloads; each inline record emission uses one TBZ full-window test on512-record windows at a32768-byte stride and two BFI field inserts in place of mask/add/or/test/branch and the second record's emission reuses the ID word and the LDADD addend carried in x1/x17 from the first (2493/4 per incidence, +1 per flush firing in the hop1 row); the candidate cap is2^24 with its Markov loss charged and q1 re-optimized; the range scan forms its dispatch index with one UBFX (25 per range); cold scalar multiplications (generator items and the resolver's verification) are charged as an itemized Jacobian double-and-add ladder with one inversion (1315823 each, 1024-instruction wrapper per point operation) instead of 512 affine operations; DONE publication/handling/wait in a separate fixed row.

experiments.purpose: Check direction/carry-specialized assembly and descriptor invariants.
